answer: Give each agent exactly one identity vertex in the live trust graph, and make climbing toward influence costly in a way farms cannot parallelize. A newcomer locks a declining saffron bond from a small, publicly audited issuance window and may hold only that vertex until three established neighbors countersign the same work receipt. Voting weight then rises only as those signatures accumulate; a clone swarm never reaches the zenith because every extra key still needs a fresh bond and fresh neighbors, and a proven fake slashes both the bond and the sponsors' stakes.
